doc Agent: Generate multi-tenant audit report. Include findings from reviewer tasks with severity ratings. Document encryption methods used for PII fields.

GKE Agent: Deploy Kubernetes manifests with HPA configuration. Configure HPA to scale based on CPU >70% or latency >300 ms. Set resource limits and requests for all containers.
